_about: Synthetic layouts and messages (every value is invented). Two tests read this file: api/test/sms_v2/layout_matcher.test.js (the server's matcher reads every message of its layout) and packages/pandapay_domain/test/sms_v2/layout_corpus_test.dart (the phone's skeleton of each message, where skeleton is true, IS the layout). Together they stop the matcher drifting from the skeleton.
